title: Vitrify Exact Learning: exact differential equations, changes of variable and closed forms from numerical data
abstract: arXiv:2611.30886v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Symbolic regression searches a space of expression trees for a formula that fits data. Many functions of the sciences have no finite expression over the usual operations and still satisfy a linear differential equation with polynomial coefficients. Vitrify Exact Learning takes nu- merical values of a function and proceeds in three steps. It assumes that the function, in its own variable or after a change of variable or a pushforward of a density, is annihilated by an operator with polynomial coefficients. It finds that operator as the null vector of a matrix of weak-form measurements, in which the data are integrated against test functions and never differentiated, makes the coefficients exact, and tests the exact operator on data that the fit did not read against a noise level propagated from the data. translated_title: Vitrify 精确学习：从数值数据中获得精确微分方程、变量替换与闭式解
translated_abstract: 符号回归在表达式树的空间中搜索一个能够拟合数据的公式。科学中的许多函数在通常的运算下没有有限的表达式，却仍然满足一个具有多项式系数的线性微分方程。Vitrify Exact Learning 接收一个函数的数值数据并分三步进行处理。它假设该函数（在其自身变量下，或经过变量替换、或经过密度的推前之后）被某个具有多项式系数的算子湮灭。它将该算子作为弱形式测量矩阵的零向量来找，其中数据与测试函数进行积分而从不被求导，随后将系数精确化，并在拟合过程未读取过的数据上、参照从数据传播而来的噪声水平对精确算子进行检验。接着它对精确算子进行符号求解，并保留与数据相匹配的闭式形式。每一步都有先例；这种组合……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 Vitrify Exact Learning 方法，通过弱形式测量（只积分不求导）从数值数据中精确恢复多项式系数线性微分方程，支持变量替换与密度推前，并经符号求解得到与数据匹配的闭式解。
en_tdlr: Vitrify Exact Learning recovers exact polynomial-coefficient linear differential equations (including changes of variable and density pushforwards) from numerical data via weak-form measurements that integrate but never differentiate, then solves them symbolically to retain closed forms matching the data.
